build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where two dynamic bars must touch each other
create_dynamic_bars: create two vertical dynamic bars positioned at scene margins using C.add
create_static_obstacles: create static bar obstacles for dynamic bars to vault over
update_task_relationships: update the task goal to require two bodies to be touching
set_solution_metadata: set the solution tier metadata to PRE_TWO_BALLS for the task
